sentences.text:
Shri Raghunandan Soni, learned counsel for the appell
 Shri H.S. Rathore, learned Ga for the respondent/Stat
Heard on Ia No.4045/2025 , which is the first application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. on
behalf of the appellant - Vesta for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

02. The appellant has been convicted for offences under Sections 363, 376(3) of the Ipc and 5(L)/6
of the Pocso Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, R.I. for 20 years
with fine of Rs.1,000/- and R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively with usual default
stipulation.
03.  Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
There is no DNA or FSL to confirm the charge of Section 376(3) of the IPC and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
He has undergone the sentence of section 363 of the IPC.
He has completed 6 years of jail incarceration.
This appeal is of the year 2020 and its final disposal will take considerable long time.
Hence, in such circumstances, prayer is made for suspension of the jail sentence and grant of bail.
04. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

2 CRA-4567-2020 05. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of appellant deserves to be allowed.
06. Accordingly, IA No.4045/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant - Vesta is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that Vesta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105032545/
1 appellant be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 10.11.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for hearing in due course.
C.c. as per rules.
